verses.en: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.sm: Aselu. Filisitia ia Isaraelu; ona sosola lea o tagata Isaraelu ai luma o Filisitia, ua pauu i latou i le mauga o Kilepoa ua manunua.

verses.en: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.sm: Ua tulitatao Filisitia ia Saulo ma ona atalii, ma ua fasiotia e Filisitia O Ionatana, ma Apinatapa, ma MakiO le oti o Saulo sua, o atalii o Saulo.

verses.en: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
verses.sm: Ua mamafa le taua ia Saulo, ua maua atu o ja e tagata fanafana u, ma ua manua o ia i e na fanafana.

verses.en: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu lea o Saulo i lona soātau, Ina to ae ia lau pelu, ma tutu°i mai ia te au, neʻi oo mai na tagata le peritomeina, ma faaleaga mai ia te au; a ua le mafai lona soátau, aua ua tele lona fefe; ona tago ai lea o Saulo i le pelu, ma faapaù i ona luga.

verses.en: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.sm: Ua vaai lona soátau, ua oti Saulo, ona faapaú foi lea o ia i luga o le pelu, ua oti ai.

verses.en: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.sm: O lea ua oti ai Saulo, ma ona atalii e toatolu, ma lona aiga uma ua oti faatasi.

verses.en: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.sm: Ua vaai tagata o Isaraelu uma sa i le vanu, ua sosola i latou, ma ua oti Saulo ma ona atalii; ona tiai ai lea e i latou o a latou aai, ma sosola i latou; ona o mai lea o Filisitia, ma nonofo ai.

verses.en: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.sm: Ua oo i le taeao, ona o atu lea o Filisitia e tatala ofu o e na fasia; ona latou maua lea o Saulo ma ona atalii o loo taatitia i le mauga o Kilepoa.

verses.en: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.sm: Ua latou talaeseina ona ofu, ona latou ave ai lea o lona ulu ma ana auupega; ona latou tuu savali ai lea i le nuu o Filisitia, ia faataamilo ona tajai i a latou tupua, atoa ma le nuu.

verses.en: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.sm: Ua latou tuu ona ofutau i le fale o latou atua, ma ua faamauina lona ulupoo ile fale o Takono.

verses.en: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.sm: Ua faalogo lapese-Kiliata uma i mea uma sa faia e Filisitia ia Saulo,

verses.en: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.sm: ona tutú ai lea o tagata totoa uma, ma ua latou ave le tino o Saulo ma tino o ona atalii, ua au mai i lapese, ua tanu o latou ivi i lalo ‘o le tapeneto i lapese, ma ua latou anapopogi ai i aso E fitu.

verses.en: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the LORD, even against the word of the LORD, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to enquire of it;
verses.sm: O lea na oti ai Saulo ona o lana agasala na na agasala atu ai i le ALII, o le afioga lava a le ALII na ia le usiusitai i ai, ua saili foi i le aitu vavalo e fesili i ai.

verses.en: And enquired not of the LORD: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
verses.sm: A ua le fesili atu i le ALII, o le mea lea na fasiotia ai o ia; ua liua foi le malo mo Tavita le atalii o
